IDiscussionBoardDailyStats.IRequest.description: Request for paginated, filterable retrieval of daily statistics OLAP aggregates. Follows the schema for fields in 'discussion_board_daily_stats'. All properties are optional for flexible business/BI queries.

IPageIDiscussionBoardDailyStats.description: Paginated OLAP daily statistics result type. Includes aggregated page information and array of daily stats objects.

id.description: Primary key for this day's stats record.

date_utc.description: UTC datetime (at midnight) for this day's aggregate metrics (partition key); unique per day.

posts_count.description: Number of posts made on this day.

comments_count.description: Number of comments created on this day.

reports_count.description: Total number of abuse/policy violation reports on this day.

new_user_signups_count.description: How many new users registered on this day.

active_users_count.description: Unique active contributor count (post/comment/vote) for this day.

traffic_sessions_count.description: Total site/service visits that day (all roles).

created_at.description: Time when this record was created (not day itself).

updated_at.description: Last time the record was updated.

IDiscussionBoardDailyStats.description: Daily aggregate OLAP metric record for discussion board. Each record aggregates post/comment/vote/report/signups and traffic for 1 day (UTC).

date_utc.description: UTC midnight datetime for new stats record (partition key).

comments_count.description: Initial comment count for the day.

reports_count.description: Initial report count (abuse/violation) for this date.

new_user_signups_count.description: Initial count of new member signups on the day.

active_users_count.description: Initial count of unique active users for this day.

traffic_sessions_count.description: Initial number of sessions but must be >= 0.

IDiscussionBoardDailyStats.ICreate.description: Creation request for a new daily OLAP stats aggregate for the discussion board. All fields required for typical initialization/import/backfill.

IDiscussionBoardDailyStats.IUpdate.description: Update payload for a daily statistics record in the 'discussion_board_daily_stats' table. All fields are optional; include only those that should be modified. This type allows administrators to correct or patch OLAP aggregate metrics for a specific date. Only admin users can update daily stats. The request body must provide values according to the business validation rules (e.g., positive counts, correct date format).

date_utc.description: UTC date (midnight) for which the stats are recorded. This field must not be changed unless correcting a record for the intended date. ISO 8601 date string (e.g., '2025-08-12T00:00:00Z').

posts_count.description: Number of new posts created on the given date. Correct for engagement and KPI calculations.

comments_count.description: Number of comments created on this day.

votes_up_count.description: Total upvotes made across all posts and comments during the day.

votes_down_count.description: Total downvotes made for all content on this date.

new_user_signups_count.description: Number of new users registered on this day.

active_users_count.description: Unique users who actively contributed (post/comment/vote) during the day.

traffic_sessions_count.description: Total sessions (visits) recorded for the site/service on this date.

IGuestAuthGuestSignInRequest.description: Request to issue a guest JWT token. Collects minimal data to track session and rate limit guests on signup. No user PII collected—just tracking metadata.

user_agent.description: User agent string from the browser/device for session identification. Required.

ip_address.description: Requestor's IP address as seen by the backend. Required; used for abuse prevention, rate-limiting.

IGuestAuthGuestSignInResponse.description: Response object for guest sign-in, issuing a JWT for guest session. Includes setHeaders for client SDKs to comply with session policy.

token.description: JWT guest access token. Used as Authorization header for subsequent API calls.

setHeaders.description: Object with HTTP headers (for easy SDK usage). Contains an Authorization: <token> property.

Authorization.description: Bearer <JWT token> used for Authorization header.

IGuestAuthGuestSignOutResponse.description: Response object indicating successful logout (session/token invalidation) for guest. No returned properties (confirmation only). This type exists for OpenAPI completeness.

IGuestAuthGuestValidateRequest.description: Request to validate a JWT guest token. Optionally includes extra tracing metadata (device/session).

user_agent.description: User agent string, checked against stored session; helps enforce anti-fraud policies.

ip_address.description: IP address for session tracking and cross-check.

IGuestAuthGuestValidateResponse.description: Response for guest token validation. Indicates whether the guest session is valid and includes extra validation status metadata used for anonymous access flows.

valid.description: True if token is valid and not expired/revoked.

session_token.description: Session token for guest (if present in the system), cross-checked with the provided token.

reason.description: If not valid, provides reason (e.g., 'expired', 'invalid', 'revoked', 'not found').

IDiscussionBoardMember.ISessionProfile.description: Non-sensitive member profile returned upon registration/login/session. Does not return password hash or other confidential fields. Use for in-session UI.

id.description: Unique member ID (UUID).

email.description: Member's email address. Returned always on own profile, but hidden on unrelated users by policy.

nickname.description: Display nickname unique within the platform.

avatar_uri.description: Profile image URI. May be null if not set.

email_verified.description: True if the member has completed email verification.

status.description: Account status: 'active', 'pending_verification', 'suspended', 'withdrawn', etc.

last_login_at.description: Timestamp of last successful login. May be null if never logged in.

IStd.IConfirmation.description: Standard confirmation response for flows like logout, password change, or generic success acknowledgment. Typically includes a boolean flag but is extendable for OpenAPI compatibility.

ok.description: True if the operation was successful. False if it failed (error cases should provide error object in actual API, not this confirmation).

IStd.ITokenCheck.description: Request schema for generic JWT token validation. Used by member, moderator, admin token check endpoints. Includes basic token to be tested.

token.description: JWT token string to be validated.

IStd.IAuthStatus.description: Result schema indicating the status of an authentication token. Used after token validation (member, moderator, admin, guest flows). Indicates whether the user is authenticated and able to proceed, with reason codes for invalid, expired, or disabled accounts. May include profile subset if authenticated.

authenticated.description: True if token is valid and user is active/authenticated.

reason.description: If not authenticated, this provides the reason: ('expired', 'revoked', 'invalid', 'not found', etc.)

oneOf.description: Optional subset of user profile for successful authentication. Properties depend on user type (member, moderator, admin, guest).

profile.description: Optional subset of user profile for successful authentication. Properties depend on user type (member, moderator, admin, guest).

email.description: The moderator's unique email address. Used for correspondence, login, and matching to existing records. Must not duplicate any record in the moderator table.

assigned_by_admin_email.description: The email address of the admin assigning this moderator role. Serves as an audit trail and role assignment origin. Must correspond to a valid admin account.

password.description: Plain-text password for the moderator account (to be securely hashed before storage). Subject to platform password strength and uniqueness policies.

IModerator.SignUp.description: Payload for registering a new moderator. Contains moderator identity, role assignment, and credentials. All fields are required on creation. Used only by admins with privileged access.

moderator_id.description: UUID for the newly assigned moderator.

email.description: The moderator's email, used for authentication and notifications.

status.description: Current moderator status after sign-up (usually 'active').

assigned_at.description: Timestamp reflecting when the moderator assignment was created.

token.description: JWT authentication token issued upon moderator sign-up.

Authorization.description: Header content containing the Bearer token, e.g., 'Bearer <JWT>'. Must be set by the client for subsequent API call authentication.

setHeaders.description: HTTP headers to auto-set Authorization (supports SDK automation).

IModerator.SignUpResponse.description: Response body returned after successful moderator sign-up. Contains the assigned moderator identity, issued JWT, and HTTP headers for automated session management.

password.description: Plain-text password to be validated securely by the system.

IModerator.SignIn.description: Request body for moderator login. Requires email and corresponding password per moderator table. Password must be provided in plain text and securely compared against stored hash.

token.description: JWT session token issued on successful login.

Authorization.description: HTTP Authorization header with Bearer token for SDK/API session injection.

setHeaders.description: Header content to set JWT for future API requests.

IModerator.SignInResponse.description: Session info and JWT returned on moderator sign-in. Used for client-side persistence and SDK auto-authentication.

success.description: Indicates whether the moderator successfully logged out (token revoked/stateless session ended).

IModerator.SignOutResponse.description: Response to moderator logout request, indicating logout status only. No sensitive data returned.

token.description: JWT token string issued to moderator client for session validation.

IModerator.ValidateTokenRequest.description: Request body for moderator JWT validation endpoint. Supplies JWT for verification. Required property is the token string.

valid.description: Indicates whether the provided JWT is valid and current (true = valid, false = invalid/expired/suspended).

moderator_id.description: UUID of the moderator, if JWT is valid and not expired. Set to null if invalid.

email.description: Email of the moderator if JWT is valid, else null.

status.description: Moderator account status (if validated), such as 'active', 'revoked', 'suspended'.

IModerator.ValidateTokenResponse.description: Response for moderator token validation. Shows whether the session token is valid, and optionally the associated moderator and status.

old_password.description: Current password of the moderator in plain text, required for verification before update.

new_password.description: New password for the moderator. Must meet all system complexity and security rules.

IModerator.ChangePassword.description: Request payload for moderator to change their password securely. Both current and intended new password must be provided, both as strings.

success.description: Indicates if the password change operation was completed successfully.

IModerator.ChangePasswordResponse.description: Response for moderator password change. Only returns status, no sensitive data.

email.description: New admin user's email for login and notifications. Must be unique in the admin table per schema comment.

password.description: Plain-text password for the new admin to use (hashed internally in storage). Must meet system strength requirements.

IDiscussionBoardAdmin.ICreate.description: Request payload for creating a new administrator account. Requires unique email and password. Used by provision workflow, not open to the public.

admin_id.description: UUID assigned to the new or authenticated admin account.

email.description: Admin email for correspondence and identity.

access_token.description: JWT access token (for session authentication) issued on sign-up or sign-in.

refresh_token.description: JWT refresh token (for prolonged session/lifecycle management).

Authorization.description: Header value for Authorization with 'Bearer <JWT access token>'.

setHeaders.description: HTTP header assigning Authorization for client SDKs or HTTP sessions.

IDiscussionBoardAdminAuthResponse.description: Response body returned for admin account creation or authentication. Contains admin identity, JWTs, and session header details.

IDiscussionBoardAdmin.ILogin.description: Login request object for discussion board administrator authentication. This type is used to provide credentials when an admin user attempts to sign in. It contains the administrator's unique email address and the account password in plain text. On submission, the backend hashes the password and checks the admin's credentials against stored records. Upon success, a JWT access token is issued for further authenticated operations. This object aligns with the 'discussion_board_admins' Prisma schema for login identity fields.

email.description: The email address of the administrator attempting to log in. Must exactly match the email stored in the admin user table. Used for unique identification and login authentication.

password.description: The cleartext password string provided by the admin at login. The API will hash this and compare to the stored password_hash field. Minimum complexity and non-emptiness are required by business policy.

IVoidSuccess.description: Standard operation result indicating successful completion of an endpoint with no additional response payload. Used for DELETE and logout endpoints that have no business data to return. No properties are present; the existence of this object itself signals success.

IValidateToken.Request.description: Request payload for token validation operations. This type contains only the JWT token string to be checked. It is required by authentication/validate endpoints for verifying token signature, expiry, issuer, and embedded claims. Applicable to admin, moderator, and member roles.

token.description: The JWT string to validate. Must be a non-empty, syntactically valid JWT (header.payload.signature).

IValidateToken.Response.description: Response object for JWT token validation. Indicates whether the token is valid and, if so, may include decoded claims or authentication status. Used by /validate endpoints for admins and other actor types.

isValid.description: True if the provided token is well-formed and valid (not expired or revoked).

oneOf.description: Decoded JWT payload claims if the token is valid, or null if not.

decoded.description: Decoded JWT payload claims if the token is valid, or null if not.

status.description: A machine-readable status string, e.g., 'valid', 'expired', 'invalid', 'revoked', etc.

IDiscussionBoardAdmin.IChangePassword.description: Request object for administrator password changes in the platform. Requires supply of both the current and new password for the authenticated admin. Backend securely verifies the current password before committing the update. Password fields must meet security policy for complexity and minimum length.

oldPassword.description: Current/previous password for the admin account. Used to verify identity before permitting password change.

newPassword.description: New password string to be set for the account. Must meet complexity/security requirements and cannot be empty.
